name: Our Lady and St John, Chorlton-cum-Hardy

boundary.description: From Old Trafford station, S along Warwick Road South and King’s Road to the railway. Then S along the railway to Trafford – Manchester District boundary. E along that boundary to Upper Chorlton Road, Milton Grove, York Avenue, then E along Clarendon Road, Marlborough Avenue, E along Manley Road, Morville Road, Wilbraham Road, Wyverne Road and Egerton Road South to Withington Road. Then S along Withington Road, W along Mauldeth Road West, Hardy Lane to the end of the road and by a beeline to River Mersey, including Betel UK – Manchester. Then W to and along Trafford – Manchester District boundary (River Mersey, Chorlton Brook, Turn Moss Road) to the point opposite Newport Road and by a straight line NW to the bend on Cromwell Road near Kings Road, and by Cromwell Road, Kings Road, Great Stone Road to and E along the railway to Old Trafford station.
